name: CrowdStrike Falcon Next-Gen SIEM
summary: Falcon Next-Gen SIEM is CrowdStrike's SIEM for third-party security and IT data as well as Falcon telemetry. Its product page shows per-endpoint pricing labels but no figures.

facts.text: The page says Falcon Next-Gen SIEM can analyze third-party security and IT data without other Falcon modules.
The page says federated search gives teams access to the right data when they need it, including S3 and Snowflake sources.
The page says data from licensed Falcon modules comes in without additional ingestion charges.
The page says the SIEM correlates agent behavior with identity and endpoint activity after it learns normal patterns.
The page describes coordinated expert agents that investigate across every associated domain at once.

plans.name: Falcon Next-Gen SIEM
plans.notes: The cart widget shows the labels per endpoint per year and per endpoint per month, with no figures.

hiddenCosts: No price figure appears on the product page, and the page links to a separate pricing page that we did not read.
